article_notes: Cross-sectional study of 29 B. canis dogs vs 10 healthy controls (private practice, Belgrade). All infected dogs recovered (15-day follow-up), so no outcome comparison was possible; the authors state this as a limitation. Only infected-vs-healthy comparisons (Table 1, SAA, lipids, lipoproteins, ApoA-1) and correlations among SAA, ApoA-1 and HDL diameter within infected dogs (not against a severity measure). Nothing against severity to extract.
